title: pvInSituParticlePath
body:
## pvInSituParticlePath

Parallel particle-path (pathline) tracer intended for in-situ use, e.g. inside a Catalyst pipeline that advances with a running simulation. Seeds from SeedSource are advected through the time-varying point vector field of Input; it adds options to clear the particle cache, keep advecting from previously computed particles (RestartSource) after a simulation restart, and start at FirstTimeStep. Output is polydata. For post-processing saved time series use pvParticlePath or pvParticleTracer.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Particle paths need the pipeline to step through time; a single update at one time produces only the seeds.
- The vector field must be point data; convert cell vectors with cellToPoint.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `InSituParticlePath`. Identity: `filters/InSituParticlePath`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: Specify which is the Input of the StreamTracer filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 3 components. | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `RestartSource` | Optional data input for the native RestartSource port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Specify the restart dataset. This is optional and can be used to have particle histories that were computed previously be included in this filter's computation. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | False | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ClearCache` | Clear the particle cache from previous time steps. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeVorticity` | Compute vorticity and angular rotation of particles as they progress | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DisableResetCache` | Prevents cache from getting reset so that new computation always start from previous results. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FirstTimeStep` | Set the first time step. Default is 0. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ForceReinjectionEveryNSteps` | When animating particles, it is nice to inject new ones every Nth step to produce a continuous flow. Setting ForceReinjectionEveryNSteps to a non zero value will cause the particle source to reinject particles every Nth step even if it is otherwise unchanged. Note that if the particle source is also animated, this flag will be redundant as the particles will be reinjected whenever the source changes anyway. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `InterpolatorType` | This property determines which interpolator to use for evaluating the velocity vector field. The first is faster though the second is more robust in locating cells during streamline integration. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Interpolator with Point Locator","Interpolator with Cell Locator"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Interpolator with Point Locator"` |
| `MeshOverTime` | The input mesh can either be 1) different over time, or 2) static over time, or 3) a linear transformation of the first time step over time, or 4) have the same topology over time. If a value other than Different are used, then performance can be improved significantly because certain data structures, such as locators or cell links are not rebuilt for each timestep. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Different","Static","Linear Transformation","Same Topology"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Different"` |
| `RestartedSimulation` | Specify whether or not this is a restarted simulation. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SelectInputVectors` | Specify which vector array should be used for the integration through that filter. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `StaticSeeds` | If the input seeds are not changing, then this can be set to 1 to avoid having to do a repeated grid search that would return the exact same result. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `TerminalSpeed` | This property specifies the terminal speed, below which particle advection/integration is terminated. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `TerminationTime` | Setting TerminationTime to a positive value will cause particles to terminate when the time is reached. The units of time should be consistent with the primary time variable. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvInSituParticlePath",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ],
    "SeedSource": [
      "UPSTREAM_SeedSource"
    ]
  }
}
```
